name: Zadok
overview: Zadok is a male figure noted for his role in the restoration of Jerusalem's walls. Specifically, he repaired the section of the wall in front of his house, demonstrating his commitment to the physical and spiritual rebuilding of the city. No tribal affiliation or additional notes are recorded for him.
namesAndTitles: The name Zadok means 'righteous one,' reflecting a character associated with righteousness. This proper name is mentioned in Nehemiah 3:29 and was not given by God but is significant in its Hebrew meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records that Zadok was the son of Immer, establishing a direct familial link. Beyond this, no further family relationships are noted in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zadok's significance lies in his active participation in the post-exilic rebuilding efforts in Jerusalem, particularly in repairing the city's defenses. His work on the wall in front of his house symbolizes personal responsibility and dedication to communal restoration. Through his actions, Zadok contributes to the broader narrative of God's people returning to their land and reestablishing their covenant community.
